messages:
Sam: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Sam: Done: finalized the launch checklist for the routing feature, merged the doc updates and small UI polish (PR #842).
Sam: Blockers: need product sign-off on the retry/backoff section in the spec (see doc link) and waiting on Marco's e2e flake fix to get a clean smoke pass from QA.
Sam: Today: will chase the sign-off, pair with Marco to reproduce the flake, and prioritize PR #857 (canary config) once sign-off is in.

Priya: Reviewed the retry section — left a couple inline comments. Main ask: spell out SLA targets (p50/p95/p99) for the retry policy so eng has clear tolerance.
Priya: Also flagged a UX warning about error messaging during degraded mode.

Marco: On the flake — looks like a race in cache invalidation when KV cache TTL expires during a concurrent batch. I have a patch but CI is red on a GPU matrix test. Repro steps coming in a minute.

Jen: Kicking a dedicated pool rebuild now to clear any infra noise — will post when done. @deploy-bot can you start the rebuild?

deploy-bot: Rebuild of dedicated-gpu-pool-3 queued by Jen at 1807654401. Estimated 6m.

Jen: Rebuild started.

Marco: Thanks. I'll rerun the failing matrix after rebuild. If it still flakes I'll post a minimal repro and a quick patch diff.

Sam: @Priya noted SLA ask — will add p50/p95/p99 to the spec and call out rollback triggers for canary.
Sam: @Jen after rebuild, can you re-run the e2e smoke job? QA is waiting to proceed with the light canary.

Jen: Yep — smoke job re-run queued.

Anil: Quick note — I can help with the perf slides for Tuesday's sales sync. Will review at 2pm PT.

Priya: On prioritization: if CI isn't stable by EOD, recommend shifting canary to tomorrow and shipping the non-blocking telemetry improvements today. Also include cost delta in rollout ticket.

Marco: Agreed. If rebuild doesn't help, we hold canary. I'll upload a small repro and the patch to the thread so reviewers can run locally.

Sam: Sounds good. I'll update the rollout ticket with the SLA numbers and the contingency plan.

Jen: Smoke job passed after rebuild — CI green on most jobs, one flaky GPU test still failing. Rerun on that one now.

Marco: Rerun looks green locally after patch `fix/cache-race` — pushing PR for review. cc @Sam @Priya for the spec alignment.

Sam: Thanks — I can review the PR in the next hour. If all looks good we'll proceed with the light canary tonight.

Priya: Thx team. If anything blocks, drop a quick note here. :thumbsup:

Sam: End of thread — will post updates when canary is scheduled.
